caption:
28 facilities: Digital Realty leads Germany in the Coloprice ranking of operators by tracked facilities.

euNetworks Group follows with 17, then Equinix with 13, and NTT Global Data Centers and Colt DCS with 9 each. Germany has 274 tracked facilities across 113 operators.

Footprints differ: euNetworks Group spans 17 cities, Digital Realty 3. Only NTT (196 MW, 8 of 9 sites) and Colt (174 MW, 4 of 9 sites) publish capacity. Largest by tracked facilities, not an endorsement.

Data: Coloprice operator rankings, 25 Nov 2026. Sources on the last slide.
